invariants: No case text, title, abstract, author, reason, notes, model output, protected data, or scientific gold may be accessed.
Normalization cannot change the frozen high-level stratum classification.
Normalization cannot bind any owner-algebra requirement group.
Provider agreement remains metadata conformance, not independent validation, R7-owner custody, recommendation/execution authority, or scientific-action gold.
Unknown or absent values remain CANNOT_CHECK.

publication_type_normalization.comparison: Compare PubMed exact set to Europe PMC set after excluding only the frozen EPMC-added lowercase JATS/PMC tokens; report excluded token frequencies and affected-record count separately.
publication_type_normalization.unknown_lowercase_or_unlisted_rule: Do not exclude; preserve exact and count as mismatch.

relation_type_normalization.comparison: Compare sets after exact frozen surface normalization only. Do not collapse direction, action class, or relation meaning.
relation_type_normalization.unmapped_rule: Preserve as EPMC_UNMAPPED::<exact token>, report frequency separately, and count the affected record as a normalized mismatch.

trigger.observed_interface_failure: Europe PMC emits human-readable relation labels and additional lowercase JATS/PMC publication types; PubMed emits DTD RefType tokens and controlled publication types. Raw exact-set comparison conflated surface serialization with structural disagreement.
trigger.preservation_rule: The raw comparison remains immutable evidence of an interface-format failure and is never silently overwritten.
